loader LEA r12 of the index it fills, and the projectile ray step loads its row from the same table
loader clears the index with memset(index, 0, slots*8)
loader row stride
loader indexes the table by the row's first dword (index[row.type] = row); the read-only live capture found u32(row,0) == slot for all 355 rows
data: 47 targets whose name hash is unique among the 355 live rows have it at +0x08 with the old impact explosion at +0x90 (identity guard only)
data, as NAME; the derived old->new explosion map is a function and order preserving

the projectile ray step reads the row's raycast template and indexes the query handle table with it; the unique matching instruction pair moved +0xF4 -> +0xF8 (the climbable slot moved 0xAC -> 0xB4 in the same pair); the live capture shows +0xF8 in {0,2,3} and a new non-template field at +0xF4
template 0 = query slot 0x8 = damage_query (murmur 0x393d9518) flags 0x80000009 in both builds

the query table gained a slot at template 1 (damage_query flags 0x80000001); every old slot 1..33 equals new slot 2..34, so damage_no_foliage_query (murmur 0xeaf0a29f) moved from template 2 to 3; new template 2 is the back-face damage_query (old 1). Keeping 2 would have given the targets back-face damage_query
